retrievalProfile.description: A central figure in a dynamic, expressive pose framed by a high-contrast concentric vortex of blurred circular rings.
excludeWhen: modern digital clean-cut aesthetics are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in a fringed suede outfit performing an intense, muscular pose, set against a background of swirling, blurred concentric circles that create a tunnel-like depth effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a circular vortex
Typography follows the upper curve of the inner circle
High contrast between the warm skin/suede tones and the cool/neutral vortex rings
Fringe elements provide vertical texture against the circular background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-full shot, subject occupies the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's clenched fists and facial expression.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion from the outer rings leads the eye inward to the subject's face, then upward to the display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The outer corners of the square frame containing the blurred vortex rings.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and tans (subject's clothing and skin).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the background rings; medium saturation in the subject's warm tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones and grayscale for the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two-tone color split within the same heavy weight font family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence.
Provides the necessary ultra-condensed blocky feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a 1970s fringe suede jacket in a dynamic pose, centered inside a high-contrast black and white concentric circular motion blur vortex.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy, slanted, condensed sans-serif text in uppercase along the top curve of the inner vortex, using black for the first half and orange for the second half.

verificationChecks: Is the background a concentric vortex?
Is the text heavy and slanted?
Is the subject in a dynamic, expressive pose?
Is the color palette dominated by earth tones and grayscale?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vortex rings are centered on the subject.
Check that the text follows the circular path of the background.
Verify the fringe on the jacket is clearly visible and adds texture.
Confirm the typography is legible against the busy background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in dynamic pose + Concentric motion blur vortex + Heavy slanted display type = Soul Kinetic Aesthetic
